title: Compatible homogeneous polynomial bar evaluation data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra field $F$, and $r\geq0$. Use the continuous scalar ring of [def-sfb-bundled-continuous-scalar-ring], the lattice $L=\mathbf Z_\ell^r$ of [def-sfb-ladic-lattice], internal module objects and actions of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define the following compatible-data specification. A homogeneous polynomial complex $K$ is a nonnegative equivariant cochain complex whose underlying term $K^n$ is an internal coproduct of copies of $A_F$ on monomials in $(n+1)r$ variables, using [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. On every section coefficient and monomial the action of $g\in C(S,L)$ substitutes $y_{a,i}-g_i$, and the differential substitutes the alternating coordinate deletions. Integer finite polynomial arrows and the inhomogeneous complex $P$ use [def-sfb-polynomial-bar-cochain-model]. A homogeneous function complex $R$ is a nonnegative equivariant complex with degree-$n$ equivariant identifications to a model of [def-sfb-condensed-homogeneous-functions] for the trivial scalar module; its differential evaluates after every $T\to S$ as the alternating sum of coordinate deletions. A fixed-subcomplex datum is an internal module complex with a cochain inclusion, injective on sections, whose image in every degree consists exactly of the sections fixed after every further profinite base change. Compatible augmented evaluation data consist of these $K,R,P$, internal-function and inhomogeneous bar data of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], constant equivariant augmentation cocycles $a:A\to K^0$, $b:A\to R^0$, an equivariant cochain map $e:K\to R$ with $a e^0=b$, and the following equations. The map $a$ is the constant-monomial coprojection and $b$ evaluates to the restricted coefficient. On every monomial, section coefficient and every profinite base change, $e^n(cy^m)(x)=c|_T\prod_{a,i}(x_a)_i^{m_{a,i}}$. A cochain isomorphism $\phi:P\simeq K^L$ composes with the fixed inclusion as substitution by consecutive differences $y_{a+1}-y_a$. A cochain isomorphism $\chi:R^L\simeq U_A$ is specified on every slice by evaluating at the prefix tuple $(0,g_1,g_1+g_2,\ldots,g_1+\cdots+g_n)$. A restricted evaluation map $e^L:K^L\to R^L$ commutes with both fixed inclusions and $e$. An evaluation datum $\rho$ in the sense of [def-sfb-polynomial-bar-cochain-model] satisfies $\rho=\phi e^L\chi$. All nonnegative complexes are understood as extended by zero in negative degrees. Prefix sums and finite products include arity zero and rank zero. This defines a type of specified compatible data, and asserts neither its inhabitation nor any higher acyclicity.
